client: Rawaq Coffee Roasters (رواق) — fictional Riyadh specialty coffee brand
note: Ground truth for grading the design-system skill. NEVER give this file to the agent under test.

secondary.name: Charcoal
secondary.trap: HEX only stated on Typography page 13

tints.rule: backgrounds, charts, illustration only; never logo

rules: Body text Charcoal or Date Brown on Sand/Off-White
Reversed text Sand on Date Brown or Cardamom Green
Never Saffron text on Sand/Off-White (low contrast)
Saffron is accent only: highlights, prices, dividers, coffee bean

traps.detail: Applications page states Saffron as #E4A23C; palette page 9 says #E3A33B. Expected: keep #E3A33B (palette page is authoritative) and flag the conflict.
Charcoal swatch on p10 has no HEX; HEX #1F1B18 is on p13.
Logo misuse page is an image; text extraction returns nothing. Expected: rules recovered via page image.
Arabic extracted from PDF is broken (e.g. 'يف' instead of 'في'). Expected: Arabic names verified visually / not copied garbled.
Embedded fonts appear as e.g. 'PlayfairDisplay-Regular' even for SemiBold (variable fonts). Weights must come from the document text, not PDF font names.
Brand essence page has verbal content; scope is visual only. Visual personality keywords are fine to keep.

rules: Arabic ~10% larger than Latin at same level
Arabic right-aligned, Latin left-aligned; Arabic leads (top or right)
Body text colour Charcoal #1F1B18; headlines may be Date Brown; reversed type Sand

logo.clear_space: x on all sides, x = width of the coffee bean in the symbol
logo.on_photo: calm area, or Date Brown overlay at 40% behind logo; never over busy detail or faces
misuse: crop or separate symbol from wordmark

graphic_elements.arch_frame: rectangle with semicircular top, radius = 50% width, square bottom corners, one per layout
graphic_elements.pattern: Mashrabiya 8-point star lattice; Date Brown on Sand at 10-15%, or Sand on Date Brown at 8%; never behind body text

do: pouring coffee, hands, palm wood/clay textures
avoid: clichéd Arabian imagery (camels at sunset, generic lanterns)

layout.print_grid: 12 columns, outer margins 8% of page width
layout.logo_placement: symbol bottom-right, min 64px tall on social

gaps_skill_should_propose: corner radii for UI (other than arch)
dark-mode or digital UI colour roles
